reading_route.title: An author builds code without gaining admission authority

section.claim_ref: An external author produced the accepted football extension; functional acceptance, source admission and local action authority remained distinct.
The author-visible input separated general architectural mechanisms and non-football examples from the football task and its explicit profile.
Author text-editing tools, source review, restricted execution, independent examination and repository admission were distinct boundaries.
The recorded chronology distinguishes transport/preflight work, separate cold trials, reviewer preparation, an amended continuation and later engineering admission.
The revised general E/B/C contract replaced a causally inconsistent equality with independently checked producer, publication and consumer relationships.
G54D’s last failure was a missing real local Root refusal; the precise diagnostic arrived after the original three-correction budget.
G54D1 used one explicit fourth correction in a recorded restored continuation, with declared seed, feedback and omissions; it was not a new cold trial.
The exact 24-file pack reconstructs as 23 author-created files plus broker-generated candidate.json; no supervisory implementation edits occurred.
Both REVOKED events now join an actual local BLOCKED_FAIL_CLOSED decision to the original request and authenticated terminal source/status, with no booking effect.
Final D1 acceptance includes 16 native cases, separate real runtime semantic inputs and two equal pure supplied results under unchanged D-to-D1 technical predicates.
G55L admitted and published the exact engineering result as commit 64f2b38…; engineering completion is distinct from G56 documentation closure.
The usable kit transfers supported construction interfaces and an explicit review path; integrated Factory and cognitive extensions remain deferred.
General HOW, domain WHAT and the private examiner occupy distinct input boundaries.
Author, broker, runner and trusted reviewer have different roles and access.
Recorded edits reconstruct 23 author files; the broker produces the separate package manifest.
Success follows an explicit fourth correction in a restored continuation; earlier failures remain.
The last correction adds a genuine Root refusal while D-to-D1 technical predicates stay fixed.
G55L admits, commits and publishes the exact source and passes installed pure verification.

reading_route.orientation: The author receives the bounded construction rules, source anchors, schemas and generic numeric/two-record mock examples; WHAT is a distinct football task profile.
The candidate is editable by the author. Kernel, examiner and owner admission remain outside that author surface. Broker restrictions are not a universal hostile-Python sandbox.
G54D1 is restored continuation using gpt-6-astra / ultra / default: correction 4, submission 5, 79 broker operations in one new model turn. The prior rollout could not be resumed normally.
Seed plus recorded edits reconstruct 23 authored files; candidate.json is broker-produced, making 24 installed pack files. The additional correction adds actual Root refusal for revoked status.
B1 and D stay INCOMPLETE. The D1 success is under an explicit amendment. The technical D-to-D1 examiner predicates did not change. No integrated Capability Synthesis Factory is claimed.
